rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides OSINT (Open Source Intelligence) capabilities for EVE Online using multiple APIs including ESI, EveWho, and zKillboard to gather comprehensive intelligence on characters, corporations, and alliances by name. Built by kongyo2 with TypeScript and FastMCP, the implementation automatically resolves entity names to IDs and combines data from official EVE APIs with third-party intelligence sources to deliver detailed reports including character corporation history, security status, killmail data, corporation member lists with activity metrics, and alliance composition with growth trends. Features robust retry logic with exponential backoff, rate limiting compliance, and structured intelligence reporting, making it valuable for EVE Online players conducting reconnaissance operations, alliance leadership analyzing member activity and recruitment patterns, and security teams investigating potential threats or tracking player movements across New Eden.
